A tidy-up release: example names are now placeholders.

### What's changed
- The user guide and Help use placeholder names (such as Jane Doe) in their examples.
- The sample address shown in the template builder is now *12 Example Street, Example Town 1234*.

Nothing changes in how the program works. Existing installs keep all their templates, clients, people and settings.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.19 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.19.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
